create_QuantStub: create a QuantStub module to quantize tensors before a quantized layer in a PyTorch model
create_DeQuantStub: create a DeQuantStub module to dequantize tensors after a quantized layer in a PyTorch model
build_QuantWrapper: build a QuantWrapper to wrap a PyTorch module with QuantStub and DeQuantStub for end-to-end quantization
test_QuantStub: test the QuantStub module by instantiating it and running a forward pass on a tensor
test_QuantWrapper: test the QuantWrapper module by wrapping an nn.Linear and running a forward pass on input data
